items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 04 July 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds in places at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure is centred southwest of Land's End, with a waving frontal system over the north of Britain.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in in the east of the area until later today.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of patchy rain and drizzle for a time later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

##State of Sea##

##Visibility##
